evidence: Empty CommonJS entrypoint and sole HTTPS tarball dependency.
Fetched ltidisafe 3.9.1 preinstall invokes node test.js with stdout/stderr suppressed.
test.js calls stringToHex on os.hostname(), os.homedir(), os.userInfo().username and passes each result to getNetworkDownloadSpeedData.
The helper constructs an HTTP hostname with that hex identity and calls checkDownloadSpeed; index.js selects http/https from the URL and performs protocol.get(baseUrl).

Mocked QuickJS execution of both original JS members recorded exactly three GET destinations encoding reviewer, review-host and /home/reviewer. Interface addresses are enumerated but not sent; uptime is commented out.

native_execution_paths.active_setup: 0x401900 calls CoCreateGuid via 0x401840, forms GUID-named executable and Active Setup subkey, calls RegCreateKeyA on HKLM and writes expandable StubPath with RegSetValueExA at 0x401a4b. It reads its module through fopen/fseek/ftell/fread, patches the buffered image (mode/config), writes it through fwrite and launches the copy at 0x401b7e.
native_execution_paths.self_delete: 0x401390 obtains current module path, converts it to short form, reads COMSPEC, builds /c del <module> > nul, starts the shell at 0x4014b8 and resumes its thread at 0x4014d9.
native_execution_paths.service_hijack: Mode 1 branch extracts DLL resource 101 via 0x402460/0x4023c0, then 0x401260 opens HKLM SYSTEM/CurrentControlSet/Services/LanmanServer/Parameters, deletes ServiceDLL and replaces it with an expandable SystemRoot/System32/StormServer.dll path at 0x40133e.
native_execution_paths.injection: 0x401150 selects IE/notepad/calc, creates a child, allocates remote memory, writes the DLL pathname, resolves kernel32!LoadLibraryA and supplies that function with the remote pathname to CreateRemoteThread at 0x40123d.
limits: Both .rsrc sections are entirely zero; no executable embedded DLL remains. FindResourceA failure prevents extraction and later injection in resource-dependent branches.
Mapped code bytes at offsets 0x1000..0x2899 are identical. Differences include header timestamp/COFF fields, raw section sizes, padding and data/IAT contents.
IAT entries include resolved legacy addresses, embedded GUID-like corruption, zero pointers, and some code has invalid instructions. Successful execution is not established.
No ransomware, file encryption, WannaCry propagation, C2 tasking or DDoS execution is attributed from the collector filenames or missing payload.
metadata/encoded-payload/url is engine-generated percent-decoding of the GUID printf format, not an actual decoded network URL. No YAML shadow or exception was added.
